mask_canvas.note: Coverage masks may extend beyond the exact hex clip; the renderer applies the exact clip last. This is how the 3-board-unit bleed remains usable even on a square mask canvas.

screen_space_rules.art_rotation: never rotate raster art with 60-degree board turns
screen_space_rules.texture_sampling: sample in a screen-upright projected world space so lighting and brush direction remain screen-upright while ground remains continuous
